facts.fact: Wingu Africa's data centre in the ICT Park, Addis Ababa, was in operation hosting the ADDIX internet exchange, which had run for over a year as of September 2025 (Wingu Africa).

facts.fact: Wingu Africa describes its ICT Park data centre hosting ADDIX as tier III-certified (operator statement; certifying body not named).
